decisions.reason: As a newly launched sensor module with its own product page, it likely fits the firm's modular IoT portfolio and would usually be kept beyond its first year.
Because it explicitly replaces an older version, it appears to be the current standard product in an established line and is unlikely to be withdrawn so soon.
The MQTT proxy supports the broader ecosystem and was presented as a standalone offering, though software utilities are somewhat easier to discontinue than core hardware modules.
A CAN bus interface module matches industrial and embedded use cases typical for German electronics customers, so it would normally remain in the catalog despite being somewhat niche.
A dedicated carbon dioxide sensor module is closely aligned with the firm's sensor business and has enough application breadth to justify staying on the market.
As an accessory rather than a core module, the touch panel product is somewhat more exposed to being rationalized, but a dedicated page suggests the firm still intends to support it.
